items.original: Book online, by phone or in person. Please give us 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule so we can offer the chair to someone else. The Good Faith Exam fee ($35, or $45 with bloodwork) is non-refundable but is credited to your account. Memberships are month-to-month and can be paused or cancelled with the front desk; unused services roll over. Packages and eGift cards are non-refundable. Promotions cannot be combined and may vary by location.
